svg.title: Work schema: documents, files, whiteboards, calendar, approvals
svg.desc: Spaces and pages with their versions, comments and per-person satellites; files with their extracted text and the Drive tree; whiteboards in nested folders with grants and sticky-note task links; calendar events, attendees, video meeting rooms and their satellites; requests (approvals) with templates and events, delegations and decisions, in the work schema of the workspace database. Projects and tasks are drawn in db-work.
svg.text: NOTE calendar_events.project_id, documents.project_id and decisions.project_id point to projects by value · approval_delegations is projected to employee.delegations · workspace_settings, code_counters and the outbox tables are listed in db-work
